manifest.title: Datadog metrics, APM, and Monitors
manifest.tagline: TiDB metrics in the Datadog Agent, a slow query traced to a SQL digest, four Monitors that detect and resolve
manifest.pattern: platform and SRE teams that will not approve a new database until its metrics, alerts, and traces land in the observability stack they already run

metrics.label: Queries per second
metrics.howMeasured: Datadog Metrics query API GET /api/v1/query with query=sum:tidb_cluster.tidb_executor_statement_total{*}.as_rate(), polled once per tick

metrics.label: Query mean latency
metrics.howMeasured: Datadog Metrics query API with query=(sum:tidb_cluster.tidb_server_handle_query_duration_seconds.sum{*}.as_rate() / sum:tidb_cluster.tidb_server_handle_query_duration_seconds.count{*}.as_rate()) * 1000; this is a mean, not a true p99, because the Agent integration only ships count/sum for this histogram

metrics.label: APM spans with DB tag
metrics.howMeasured: count of spans the instrumented service reports locally with a db.type: mysql tag, incremented in-process by the runner

metrics.label: Time to detect (last fault)
metrics.howMeasured: Monitor overall_state observed as Alert via 5-second polling of GET /api/v1/monitor/{id}, minus the fault injection timestamp, recorded in-process by the runner

phases.label: Steady state
phases.narration: This is the same steady workload from the Prometheus demo, but now it's also flowing through a Datadog Agent and an APM-instrumented service.

phases.label: Slow query storm
phases.narration: Watch this slow query show up as a red span in Datadog APM, tagged with the exact SQL.

phases.label: Write hot spot
phases.narration: Same hot-spot pattern as before, this time visible in the Datadog TiKV CPU metric.

phases.label: TiKV store outage
phases.narration: A node failure, and Datadog's own Monitor catches it.

phases.label: Connection surge
phases.narration: A connection leak, the same failure every on-call engineer has paged for.

phases.label: Recovery
phases.narration: Every Datadog Monitor we just triggered resolves on its own.

phases.label: Wrap-up
phases.narration: Four faults, four Datadog Monitors, one slow trace correlated straight back to a SQL digest in TiDB.

checks.label: Slow query storm monitor fired
checks.description: Polling GET /api/v1/monitor/{id} for the slow-query monitor shows overall_state Alert within its evaluation window plus one Agent collection interval of injection

checks.label: Write hot spot monitor fired
checks.description: Same polling pattern for the TiKV CPU monitor

checks.label: Store outage monitor fired
checks.description: Same polling pattern for the store-size-staleness monitor

checks.label: Connection surge monitor fired
checks.description: Same polling pattern for the connections monitor

checks.label: Slow span matches a TiDB SQL digest
checks.description: The slowest reported span's sql tag matches a QUERY_SAMPLE_TEXT row in information_schema.statements_summary

controls.label: Inject slow query storm
controls.description: Runs the slow query through the instrumented APM service and starts runSlowQueryStorm, moves to phase slow-query-storm

controls.label: Inject write hot spot
controls.description: Starts runWriteHotSpot, moves to phase write-hot-spot

controls.label: Inject TiKV store outage
controls.description: Starts stopTikvStore, moves to phase store-outage

controls.label: Inject connection surge
controls.description: Starts runConnectionSurge, moves to phase connection-surge

controls.label: Clear all faults
controls.description: Calls clearAllFaults, restarts any stopped TiKV store, moves to phase recovery

environment.tidb: tiup playground v1.16.2 (nightly-6) + TiDB v8.5.8, local
